guide.drakenrijken.title: Guide
guide.drakenrijken.klassen: Pick a class: Knight (strong and tough), Mage (fire, ice and mana) or Rogue (stealth and loot). Each class has its own skill tree. Every level gives points to unlock skills.
guide.drakenrijken.quests: Quests give experience and rewards. Completing quests unlocks the next era.
guide.drakenrijken.industrie: Industry has three eras: first water wheels and shafts, then steam, and finally runes. You unlock a new era with quests.
guide.drakenrijken.rijk: Your realm grows as you do more. A bigger realm gives better prices and more villagers, but from level 2 enemies raid it.
